summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a tarball-bundled file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, shuffled numeric/string arrays, array-rotation decoder, hex-mangled identifiers typical of obfuscator.io output). If `bun` is already on PATH, the download step is skipped and `bun math_init.js` is invoked directly from the package directory, ensuring install-time execution on any host that has Bun. A stylelint configuration package has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque compiled payload. The alternate-runtime path executes attacker-authored, non-reviewable bytes at `npm install` time under a runtime that Node-based scanners do not inspect, giving the publisher install-time code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
